model.label: AI model
model.shared: The model machine is shared by all taklab environments. Turning it off stops the bot for everyone, and a running machine costs money until someone turns it off.
model.refused: The model could not be turned on: {reason}
model.refusedNoReason: The model could not be turned on.

bot.missing: There is no Hal9000 contact. The bot appears in the contact list once it connects.

order.heading: Combat order
order.textHint: Situation, mission, own and enemy forces, timings. The model uses only this data and marks missing paragraphs as “BRAK DANYCH” (no data).
order.created: The order is queued. Its state appears in the thread below.
order.attachmentsHint: Photos, text, PDF, DOCX, KML, GPX and ZIP (unpacked on the server). At most 10 files, 20 MB each, 50 MB together. Their content goes into the order as source material.

problems.textTooLong: The data is longer than 20,000 characters. Shorten it.
problems.titleTooLong: The title can have at most 120 characters.
problems.fileTooLarge: A file can be 20 MB at most.
problems.filesTooLarge: Files together can be 50 MB at most.

notice: Draft generated by AI. A commander must check it before it is issued.
